schema.ligand_id: short unique slug used for filenames
schema.name: human-readable compound name
schema.inclusion_rationale: why this compound is in the set
schema.source: PMID:<id> or an http(s) URL (required provenance)

notes: Compounds must be sourced from real literature/databases with verifiable provenance.
Do NOT add compounds with invented SMILES, CIDs, or citations.
Populate this file, then run scripts/curate_compounds.py to validate before docking.
